Sr. Pre-qualification Criteria Technical Pre-qualification criteria: 1. The bidder shall be the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) of the offered diesel generator (DG) set with an assembly facility/works in India, or an authorized dealer of the OEM of the offered DG set whose assembly facility/works are located in India. 2. The OEM of the offered DG set shall submit the copy of authorization c ertificate from the engine manufacturer (of the offered engine make) per mitting the use of the engine for DG set manufacturing. In case the bidde r is an authorized dealer of the OEM, the dealer shall submit the copy of authorization certificate issued in the name of the OEM by the engine ma nufacturer for use of the engine in the DG set. 3. The OEM of the offered DG set shall submit a formal declaration or cer tificate confirming that the specific model offered complies with the lates t CPCB, MPCB, and MoEF&CC emission standards applicable to its rating category as of the date of the NIT. In case the bidder is an authorized de

aler of the OEM, the dealer shall submit a formal declaration or certificat e issued by the OEM confirming that the specific model offered complies with the latest CPCB, MPCB, and MoEF&CC emission standards applicable to its rating category as of the date of the NIT. 4. If the bidder is an authorized dealer of the OEM of the offered DG set, t he bidder shall submit a valid copy of authorization certificate from the O EM covering supply, installation, commissioning, servicing, post-warranty 1 AMC, and guaranteed technical backup for the offered DG set. 5. If the bidder is the OEM of the offered DG set, the OEM shall have supp lied at least one DG set of minimum 200 KVA or higher capacity with an output of 415 V AC or higher within a span of seven (7) years from the da te of the NIT/bid. As proof, the bidder shall submit the copy of purchase o rder for the DG set, along with Completion certificate / Customer Accepta nce Certificate issued by the end-user OR b. GeM CRAC (Consignee Recei pt and Acceptance Certificate) document OR c (i). Tax Invoice as an evidence of execution of the PO. 6. If the bidder is an authorized dealer of the OEM of the offered DG set, either the authorized dealer or the OEM shall have supplied at least one DG set of minimum 200 KVA or higher capacity with an output of 415 V A C or higher within a span of seven (7) years from the date of the NIT/bid. 7. If the bidder is an authorized dealer of the OEM, the bidder shall submi t the copy of purchase order for the supply of the DG set as mentioned a bove, along with Completion certificate / Customer Acceptance Certificat e issued by the end-user OR b. GeM CRAC (Consignee Receipt and Accep tance Certificate) document OR c (i). Tax Invoice as an evidence of execu tion of the PO. For authorized dealers, such documents submitted in the name of the OEM (who has authorized the dealer) shall also be accepted. i) Relaxation in Experience criteria for eligible startup for startup as per annexure X I.
